verses.text: A thoughtful psalm of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing about the LORD's faithful love forever. With my mouth I will make your faithfulness known to all generations.
I will say, "Your love stands firm forever. You set up the skies, and your faithfulness is in them."
You said, "I have made a covenant with my chosen one. I have made a promise to my servant David:
'I will make your family line last forever. I will make your throne secure for all generations.'" Selah.
LORD, the heavens praise your wonders, and your faithfulness is praised in the meeting of the holy ones.
Who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared. He is more awesome than all who surround him.
LORD God of Armies, who is as mighty as you, LORD? Your faithfulness surrounds you.
You rule over the raging sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
You crushed Rahab like someone killed in battle. With your strong arm you scattered your enemies.
The heavens belong to you, and so does the earth. You made the world and everything in it.
You created the north and the south. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon sing for joy at your name.
Your arm is powerful. Your hand is strong. Your right hand is lifted high.
Your throne is built on what is right and fair. Faithful love and truth go ahead of you.
Happy are the people who have learned to shout praise to you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.
They celebrate your name all day long. They are lifted up because you do what is right.
You are their glorious strength. Because of your kindness, our strength is lifted high.
Our shield belongs to the LORD. Our king belongs to the Holy One of Israel.
Long ago you spoke in a vision to your faithful people. You said, "I have given strength to a warrior. I have lifted up a young man chosen from among the people.
I have found my servant David. I have poured my holy oil on him to make him king.
My hand will hold him up. My arm will make him strong.
No enemy will make him pay taxes. No wicked person will crush him.
I will crush his enemies in front of him and strike down those who hate him.
My faithfulness and faithful love will be with him. Because of my name, his strength will be lifted high.
I will put his hand over the sea and his right hand over the rivers.
He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, the rock who saves me.'
I will make him my firstborn son, the greatest of the kings of the earth.
I will always keep my faithful love for him. My covenant with him will never fail.
I will make his family line last forever and his throne as long as the heavens last.
If his children turn away from my law and do not follow my rules,
if they break my laws and do not keep my commands,
then I will punish their sin with a rod and their wrongdoing with beatings.
But I will never take my faithful love away from him, or let my faithfulness fail.
I will not break my covenant or change what my lips have said.
I have made a promise by my holiness once and for all, and I will not lie to David.
His family line will last forever. His throne will last like the sun in front of me.
It will be set firmly in place forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah.
But now you have rejected and refused him. You have been angry with your anointed king.
You have broken your covenant with your servant. You have thrown his crown in the dust.
You have broken down all his walls. You have turned his fortresses into ruins.
Everyone who passes by robs him. His neighbours insult him.
You have made his enemies strong. You have made all his enemies celebrate.
You have turned back the edge of his sword. You have not helped him in battle.
You have ended his glory and thrown his throne to the ground.
You have cut short the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your anger keep burning like fire?
Remember how short my life is. You have made all people for such a short time!
Who can live and never die? Who can escape the power of the grave? Selah.
Lord, where is your faithful love of long ago, which you promised to David in your faithfulness?
Lord, remember how your servants have been insulted. I carry in my heart the insults of all the powerful nations.
Your enemies have insulted me, LORD. They have mocked every step of your anointed king.
Praise the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
